methods.name: HGEN
methods.existing_scope: Saved §§3.1–3.4/Eqs1–9 and pinned code; no primary reread
methods.mechanism: Separate per-meta-path graph learners feed residual attention and summed decoder logits; joint fused task CE plus Gram penalty. Concrete graph-semantic hidden/prediction fusion collision.
methods.limits: Independent learner encoders, learned fusion and path views differ from same-input shared slow-weight4; no useful coverage or mean-pool failure is guaranteed.

methods.name: SAGMM
methods.existing_scope: Saved method/Algorithm1/AppendixD; one new pinned author-node-code scope in this packet
methods.mechanism: Topology-context gating of heterogeneous expert states with joint task supervision; new code resolves a weighted hidden-state sum followed by a learned final classifier.
methods.limits: Native code weights are positive thresholded and not simplex-normalized. No direct per-expert CE is in the inspected main train path. Aux losses and validation-responsive pruning are native options; no fixed4 shared-bank or competence-preservation guarantee.

methods.name: GNNMoE
methods.existing_scope: Saved §3/Eqs4–9 and later attention objective scout; no primary reread
methods.mechanism: Node-specific mixing of decoupled propagation/transformation experts into one continuing representation; common-weight expert FFN. Direct trainable graph expert-fusion ancestor.
methods.limits: Does not preserve four complete private histories or supply an output-selector competence oracle.

methods.name: MoE-NP
methods.existing_scope: Saved bounded v3 method follow-up; no new primary read
methods.mechanism: Local random-walk/feature/degree and global context feed node-specific softmax expert routing.
methods.limits: Pretrained/adjustable expert variants and textual task-loss ambiguities mean a complete joint scratch4 reproduction is not assumed.

methods.limits: Graph-depth paths are not identical to four separately served member routes; no replay of closed hidden/depth head recipe.
